text:
Here is the corrected test suite in Decision Tables notation, followed by the corresponding JSON test cases:

```artifact
| Condition Combination | Action |
| --- | --- |
| Hospital staff, authorized | Show Patient Consultation requests |
| Hospital staff, unauthorized | Do not show Patient Consultation requests |
| Chemists/Labs, authorized | Show data on need-to-know basis |
| Chemists/Labs, unauthorized | Do not show data on need-to-know basis |
| High availability, yes | Ensure high availability |
| High availability, no | Do not ensure high availability |
| High reliability, yes | Ensure high reliability |
| High reliability, no | Do not ensure high reliability |
| Usability, large font size | Design screens with large font size |
| Usability, small font size | Do not design screens with large font size |
| Disease Prediction Database, updated | Improve training data-set by including actual learning |
| Disease Prediction Database, not updated | Do not improve training data-set by including actual learning |
| Patient data, confidential | Maintain confidentiality |
| Patient data, non-confidential | Do not maintain confidentiality |
| Access control, enforced | Only authorized staff can access Patient Consultation requests |
| Access control, not enforced | Authorized staff can access Patient Consultation requests |
| Data access, restricted | Show data only on need-to-know basis |
| Data access, unrestricted | Show data without restrictions |
| System, highly available | Ensure high availability |
| System, not highly available | Do not ensure high availability |
| System, highly reliable | Ensure high reliability |
| System, not highly reliable | Do not ensure high reliability |
| Month, current | Improve Disease Prediction Database with learning of the prior month |
| Month, not current | Do not improve Disease Prediction Database with learning of the prior month |
```
